name: pi-tidy
notes: Fork of Andy8647/pi-tidy. Rendering ownership and coexistence behavior are specified in openspec/changes/import-pi-tidy-fork; performance adaptations are specified in openspec/specs/tidy-transcript-rendering; fork-only logic belongs under fork/.
reapplyOnSync: Keep FORK-CHANGELOG.md in the published files list while retaining the upstream homepage/bugs/source identity.

In src/index.ts, load through fork/loadForkConfig and replace patchToolBoxFrames(options) with installForkToolFrames(config). Gate registerWritePreview and its unavailable-API warning with config.writePreview; keep the upstream test harness opted into writePreview.
Retain the xzzpig fork section and local-install commands in README.md, including runtime defaults and the pi-tool-display enableNativeUserMessageBox prerequisite.

Keep test/renderer-harness.ts explicit about upstream integration defaults (including frameTools: true) so upstream behavior tests remain baseline-focused; fork defaults are asserted in fork-only tests.
Allow wrapped terminal output in test/third-party-edit.test.ts when asserting the edit summary and long path.

Keep package.json npm identity, repository, fork changelog files, `tsx` dev dependency, `test:e2e` script, and explicit unit-test paths (including test/renderer-harness.ts) that keep E2E files out of Node's default discovery when syncing upstream.

When syncing the final-reply renderer or Pi component compatibility, re-verify fork/thinking-row.ts: retain the collapsed Pi MouseRegion outside a framed final reply and preserve click routing, unless upstream adds an equivalent coexistence path.

Keep the fork hooks in src/tools/tool-group-view.ts: (a) the component-level re-entry guard (BOUNDARY_ACTIVE) so only the outermost group-boundary wrapper restyles (a nested install passes through; otherwise pi-group-collapse's projection between installs duplicates the first retry-error line), and (b) the native-thinking switch (setNativeThinking) that makes restyleThinking return Pi's own rows when enabled and never seed thinkingVisibilityOverrides with collapsed entries (even during final-frame suppression); those entries override pi-thinking-collapse streaming expansion after a redraw. The fork-default native mode leaves thinking to Pi and pi-thinking-collapse; fork/thinking-row.ts restores settled rows outside the final frame regardless of Pi's hideThinkingBlock. Remove a hook only if upstream provides an equivalent seam.

Keep ruleRows memoization in src/turns/turn-view.ts keyed by message/content identity, turn version, width, layout mode, options revision, and current code-block list; reapply its invalidation contract after sync.
After each successful Markdown render in src/turns/turn-view.ts, prune CodeHook.built to token keys in the current Markdown tree so streaming prefixes do not accumulate.
Keep sticky candidate matching and chunked output assembly in src/messages/hex-swatches.ts; candidate regexes must match only at their current index.
Keep groupedRows cache admission in src/tools/tool-group-view.ts based on the tool's own volatility; global agentRunning state must not bypass cache for settled history.

packaging identity (repository.url, files allowlist, per-package lockfile policy) is enforced by scripts/check-fork-identity.mjs — run `node scripts/check-fork-identity.mjs` after every subtree pull/sync
Keep hover-dispatch.test.ts waiting for the first rendered layout through fork/wait-for-frame.ts before sending mouse input; fixed sleeps race the TUI render timer under parallel load.
doNotReintroduce: Do not unconditionally install the write call preview: tidy.writePreview defaults to false so Pi or pi-tool-display keeps both write renderers; writeLines alone must not enable it.
Do not reintroduce suppression of Pi’s completed thinking MouseRegion by the final-reply frame; keep the collapsed row outside the frame and preserve native expand/collapse behavior.

Do not make pi-tidy draw its own thinking row by default. The fork ships nativeThinking=true so Pi and pi-thinking-collapse own the thinking affordance; tidy's row is the opt-in `tidy.nativeThinking=false` path.

Do not restore the package-local pnpm-lock.yaml or pnpm-workspace.yaml: this fork consumes only the root pnpm workspace lock, and a local workspace root makes CI resolve pi-tidy as a standalone project.

Do not restore the global agentRunning cache bypass for grouped tool rows: settled history remains cacheable while only its own partial output, jobs, reveal timer or other volatile state requires recomputation.

knownDebt.reason: [artifact] Fork-only component-level re-entry guard (BOUNDARY_ACTIVE) for the group-boundary renderer: only the outermost install may restyle. pi-group-collapse's render projection installs between pi-tidy's two boundary installs; without the guard both wrappers remap the same rows and a retry error draws its error ×2 frame twice. Remove when upstream makes boundary installs position-independent.

[baseline] Existing pi-lens findings (12 object-parameter, 3 function-parameter-count, 1 function-too-long, 1 unnecessary-await) are on upstream-original lines outside the re-entry/native-thinking hooks and the targeted grouped-row cache predicate. Do not reformat those baseline sites as part of this performance adaptation.

[policy] Upstream package-local pnpm lock is unconsumed by this monorepo and breaks CI: running pnpm in the package directory treats it as a standalone project and its stale lock misses the tsx devDependency. Delete it again on every sync and use the root pnpm workspace lock.

[policy] Upstream package-local pnpm workspace file makes pnpm treat the package as a separate project root, bypassing the monorepo lock/build policy. Delete it again on every sync; the package is a member of the root workspace.

[policy] The final-reply code-block rule/chip scan is memoized against content and layout identity to avoid rebuilding its full-row index on stable frames. Keep this until upstream provides equivalent correct invalidation and stable-row reuse.

[policy] The derived code-block map is pruned to the current Markdown token tree so streaming prefixes do not remain retained. Keep this until upstream bounds or replaces the token cache equivalently.
[policy] Color candidates are matched at their current index and output is assembled in chunks to keep dense invalid inputs linear. Keep this until upstream implements an equivalent bounded scan.

[policy] Grouped-row cache admission depends on tool-local volatility rather than the process-wide agentRunning flag, preserving settled transcript rows during later runs. Keep this until upstream uses equivalent per-group cache invalidation.

[policy] Wait for the initial TUI layout instead of sleeping 20ms before mouse input, retaining all hover/pointer assertions under parallel test load. Remove when upstream synchronizes its initial layout in this test.
